plan.title: Modules 2-3: Installation, Project Anatomy, Authority, and Context

narratives.Description: Teach independent consumer installation, initialization, diagnosis, project anatomy, authority resolution, and lazy loading. The work includes a disposable initialization lab and a progressively hinted rule-conflict exercise.
narratives.Acceptance: Module 2 lets a learner choose among init, update, and doctor; distinguish consumer and maintainer surfaces; and prove the tracked, ignored, authoritative, and reconstitutable artifacts in a disposable repository. Module 3 lets a learner resolve USER.md, PROJECT-DEFINITION, task guidance, and framework defaults while separating behavior rules from product requirements.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: installation and project orientation; authority and lazy loading
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Author Module 2 and its disposable initialization lab

narrative.Acceptance: Verified macOS, Linux, and PowerShell paths let a learner initialize a disposable consumer repository, run current health and toolchain checks, inspect the result, reset safely, and compare evidence with an explained solution.

items.title: Author Module 3 and its authority-resolution exercise

narrative.Acceptance: A learner can resolve conflicting fictional rules through the documented authority hierarchy, explain lazy loading, use progressive hints, and verify the reasoning against a complete solution.
